page.notes: Pale, slightly stained paper at the edges; no marginal text visible. The first word's initial "A" is a large capital joined to "Riftoteles", transcribed as "ARiftoteles". The final line breaks mid-word ("materiæ-") and continues on the next page. Doubtful readings: "phyfici compofiti" (the s/f forms are hard to tell apart in the scan, transcribed as plain s), "fitne" in the penultimate sentence.
